weeks.title: Introduction to Python and Setup
points: Install Python and set up a development environment using VS Code or IDLE
Understand what Python is and where it is used in the real world
Write and run your first Python script using print statements

weeks.title: Variables, Data Types, and Input
points: Declare variables and understand string, integer, float, and boolean types
Use the input() function to accept data from the user
Practice type conversion between int, float, and string

weeks.title: Operators and Expressions
points: Use arithmetic operators: addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, modulus
Understand comparison operators and how they return True or False
Combine operators in expressions and understand operator precedence

weeks.title: Conditional Statements
points: Write if, elif, and else blocks to control program flow
Use logical operators (and, or, not) to combine conditions
Build a simple decision-making program such as a grade calculator

weeks.title: Loops
points: Use for loops to iterate over ranges and sequences
Use while loops to repeat code while a condition is true
Apply break and continue to control loop execution

weeks.title: Lists and Tuples
points: Create and access elements in a list using indexing and slicing
Use list methods like append, remove, sort, and len
Understand tuples as immutable sequences and when to use them

weeks.title: Dictionaries and Sets
points: Create dictionaries and access values using keys
Use dictionary methods like keys(), values(), items(), and update()
Understand sets and perform union, intersection, and difference operations

weeks.title: Functions
points: Define reusable functions using def with parameters and return values
Understand the difference between local and global variable scope
Use default parameter values and keyword arguments in function calls

weeks.title: File Handling and Error Handling
points: Open, read, write, and close files using open() and the with statement
Handle errors gracefully using try, except, and finally blocks
Raise and create custom exceptions for better program control

weeks.title: Modules, Packages, and Final Project
points: Import and use built-in modules like math, random, and datetime
Understand how to install and import third-party packages using pip
Build a small command-line project combining all concepts learned
